The Frontier Guard Commander is a living symbol of the Great Bastion—their shield represents the Bastion's gates, their armour the indestructible Bastion itself, and the mystic torch they bear is quite literally a part of the Bastion's beacon fires, used to signal enemy movements and guide Cathay's armies. To the soldiers guarding the Bastion, the beacon fires are both a signal of battle and a symbol of hope—for wherever they burn, the Frontier Guard Commander stands with them.
This man believes that one must secure an unassailable position before seeking battle, and so he drills the Jade Warriors extensively in formation, striving for an unshakeable defensive line.
This man believes cavalry charges are the key to victory, and so has focused his training efforts on cavalry, with his Jade Lancers rivaling the finest cavalry of any nation.
This man believes the crossbow to be a formidable tool of defense, and spares no expense to equip his Jade Crossbowmen with additional ammunition.
Cathay's barded warhorses are not particularly powerful in build, but possess remarkable stamina, sufficient for prolonged campaigns.
